description: This PHP class defines the TimeConfigPeriod data transfer object (DTO) for the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It encapsulates a single property 'startDay' with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriod
classes.description: A DTO class representing a time configuration period with a start day property.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Returns the start day of the time configuration period.

methods.name: setStartDay
methods.description: Sets the start day of the time configuration period.
